games.title: 果凍摩天樓

proof.claim: 100 legal parameter constructions and start/held-control traces replay through the released 60 Hz physical model and independent objective checker. Each level also has a separately replayed alternate valid construction. Mechanical challenges are certified only against standard AI; no uniqueness or arbitrary-opponent guarantee.

games.uiWitnessMapping: Select the level, select each component, type construction fields using bounded numeric inputs with step=any, then press Start. Battle holds Forward and Lower Hinge. Other models evolve without further input. Demo uses these same constructions and engine actions with assistance provenance. First/middle/last levels pass DOM-control replay; all1500 field values satisfy public UI bounds.
games.semanticDiversity: 100 engine-consumed physical configurations after stripping IDs, seeds, prose and initial editor samples; demolition and capture/sculpture audits remove relevant global translation. See verification-report.json canonical counts and each game README.

ai.role: none; deterministic causal physical experiment has no opponent
